identity.description: Fetches a GitHub PR diff and returns a line-aware code review with validated line references. Optionally submits the review to GitHub as a PENDING draft.

inputs.description: GitHub PR URL to review, with optional context and submit flag.

example.context: Adds JWT auth middleware to Express app

context.title: Context
context.description: Optional — what this PR is supposed to do

submit.title: Submit to GitHub
submit.description: If true, posts the review to GitHub as a PENDING draft. Default false.

outputs.description: Structured review: summary, risk level, line-aware comments, markdown, optional GitHub payload and review URL.

skills.name: GitHub Code Review
skills.description: Fetches PR diff, validates line references, and produces a structured, line-aware code review
